## Progress

- [PR #1440](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/1440): stage sets with visit lengths (root canal, crown or bridge, implant, braces, dentures) by service code; the plan shows done, current and next; a stage is marked done in order on a visit whose note is signed; the item is done only after its last stage; "Book the next stage" opens the schedule with patient, dentist, chair and length filled in
- Needs a person: a dentist approves the stages and lengths; braces repeat adjustments in real treatment (one adjustment stage for now)

## Description

A procedure with stages (for example root canal: access and cleaning, shaping, obturation) shows which stage is next, and booking the next visit carries the stage and its duration.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The plan shows the current and next stage of each multi-visit item.
- [ ] **AC2.** Booking the next stage opens the schedule with patient, dentist, chair and duration filled.
- [ ] **AC3.** A stage cannot be marked done on an unsigned visit.
